title: Idols and the Living God

questions.question: Thus says the Lord: "Learn not the way of the nations, nor be dismayed at the... of the heavens because the nations are dismayed at them,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:2 (ESV): "nor be dismayed at the signs of the heavens because the nations are dismayed at them,"

questions.question: "For the customs of the peoples are vanity. A tree from the forest is cut down and worked with an axe by the hands of a..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:3 (ESV): "and worked with an axe by the hands of a craftsman."

questions.question: "They decorate it with silver and gold; they fasten it with hammer and nails so that it cannot..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:4 (ESV): "they fasten it with hammer and nails so that it cannot move."

questions.question: What are their idols compared to in a cucumber field?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:5 (ESV): "Their idols are like scarecrows in a cucumber field, and they cannot speak;"

questions.question: "...they have to be..., for they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of them, for they cannot do evil, neither is it in them to do good."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:5 (ESV): "they have to be carried, for they cannot walk."

questions.question: "There is none like you, O Lord; you are..., and your name is great in might."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:6 (ESV): "There is none like you, O Lord; you are great, and your name is great in might."

questions.question: "But the Lord is the... God; he is the living God and the everlasting King."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:10 (ESV): "But the Lord is the true God; he is the living God and the everlasting King."

questions.question: "It is he who made the earth by his power, who established the world by his..., and by his understanding stretched out the heavens."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:12 (ESV): "who established the world by his wisdom,"

questions.question: "When he utters his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he makes the... rise from the ends of the earth."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:13 (ESV): "and he makes the mist rise from the ends of the earth."

questions.question: "He makes lightning for the rain, and he brings forth the... from his storehouses."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:13 (ESV): "and he brings forth the wind from his storehouses."

questions.question: "Every man is stupid and without knowledge; every... is put to shame by his idols, for his images are false, and there is no breath in them."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:14 (ESV): "every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols,"

questions.question: "Not like these is he who is the portion of..., for he is the one who formed all things,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:16 (ESV): "Not like these is he who is the portion of Jacob, for he is the one who formed all things,"

questions.question: What is the name of the one who is the portion of Jacob and formed all things?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:16 (ESV): "the Lord of hosts is his name."

questions.question: "For the shepherds are stupid and do not inquire of the...; therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:21 (ESV): "For the shepherds are stupid and do not inquire of the Lord;"

questions.question: "Correct me, O Lord, but in...; not in your anger, lest you bring me to nothing."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 10:24 (ESV): "Correct me, O Lord, but in justice; not in your anger, lest you bring me to nothing."

key_verse_text: But the Lord is the true God; he is the living God and the everlasting King. At his wrath the earth quakes, and the nations cannot endure his indignation.
